definitions.explanation: A geological fault that has moved in the recent geological past and is likely to move again, causing an earthquake. Japan has some two thousand known active faults, and their locations matter for building and disaster planning.

examples.japanese: {活断層|かつだんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。

examples.english: There is an active fault under this town.

examples.japanese: {阪神|はんしん}・{淡路|あわじ}{大震災|だいしんさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{活断層|かつだんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動|うご}いて→動く：00904_ugoku⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧だった。
examples.english: The Great Hanshin-Awaji Earthquake was caused by the movement of an active fault.

notes:
{活|かつ} (active) + ⟦{断層|だんそう}→断層：06367_dansou⟧ (fault), like ⟦{活火山|かっかざん}→活火山：15901_kakkazan⟧ (active volcano).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {活断層|かつだんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: an active fault moves (and causes an earthquake)
- {活断層|かつだんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}つ→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧: to stand on top of an active fault
- {活断層|かつだんそう}{型|がた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧: an earthquake caused by an active fault (as opposed to a subduction-zone quake)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{断層|だんそう}→断層：06367_dansou⟧: fault
- ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧: earthquake
- ⟦{震源|しんげん}→震源：16060_shingen⟧: hypocenter
